title: Crystal Bedroom Material Lab
description: A minimalistic modern bedroom contains a dispersion crystal object on the nightstand. The user acts as an interior lighting designer, adjusting material properties of the crystal (roughness, metalness, transmission, IOR, color) and the bedroom's wall/floor materials to achieve a target aesthetic score displayed on a floating HUD panel.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with importmap for three and addons. Load both GLB assets: place minimalistic_modern_bedroom.glb as the room environment centered at origin, and place DispersionTest.glb scaled to roughly 0.3 on the nightstand or central surface of the bedroom. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (3, 2.5, 4) looking at the room center. Use OrbitControls with damping enabled, constrained so the camera stays inside or near the room. Add a RectAreaLight simulating a window (warm white, intensity 8), a PointLight inside a ceiling fixture (intensity 3), and an ambient light (intensity 0.3). Enable tone mapping (ACESFilmic) and set renderer to use WebGL with antialias and alpha. Create a dat.gui or custom HTML overlay panel with these interactive controls: (1) Crystal Roughness slider 0-1, (2) Crystal Metalness slider 0-1, (3) Crystal Transmission slider 0-1 for glass-like effect, (4) Crystal IOR slider 1.0-2.5, (5) Crystal Tint color picker that applies a color to the crystal material, (6) Bedroom Wall Base Color picker that changes wall mesh materials, (7) Floor Reflectivity slider 0-1 adjusting floor material roughness inversely, (8) Window Light Intensity slider 0-20. When the scene loads, traverse both models to identify meshes. For the dispersion crystal, replace its material with a MeshPhysicalMaterial supporting transmission, thickness 0.5, and attenuationColor. For bedroom walls and floor, identify them by mesh name or index and apply MeshStandardMaterial. Display a floating HUD showing a target configuration (specific roughness, IOR, transmission, wall color values) and compute a match percentage in real-time as the user adjusts sliders. When the match exceeds 90%, display a success message with a CSS animation. All parameter changes must update materials in real-time. Ensure the renderer uses sRGB encoding and PMREMGenerator for environment reflections using the room itself as a crude reflection source.
